title: 前世の死
telop:
他人の死は見抜けた。
自分のだけは無理だった
style: anime style, cel shading, clean bold lineart, muted desaturated colors, warm orange sunset lighting, vertical 9:16 composition, no text
negative: flags, text, watermark, extra people, extra fingers, deformed hands, fantasy elements, cloak, armor, glasses, beard, stubble

ren.name: 蓮
ren.prompt: Ren, 28yo Japanese office worker man, clean-shaven, messy black hair, sleepy half-closed gray eyes, tired face with dark circles, loose dark red necktie, worn gray suit jacket, dark brown trousers, white shirt, black leather shoes, tablet in his left hand
ren.voice_note: 低めで淡々とした20〜30代の男性。異世界のアルトと同じ声にする

boy.name: 少年
boy.prompt: Japanese elementary school boy about 8 years old, short black hair, red randoseru school backpack, white t-shirt, navy shorts, red sneakers

cuts.image_prompt: wide shot of the old rusty pedestrian overpass in a small Japanese city at orange sunset, Ren standing alone in the middle, looking down at the cracked deck
cuts.motion_prompt: Slow camera tilt down from the sunset sky to the lonely man standing on the overpass. Only his hair and tie move slightly in the wind.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: 他人の死は、だいたい見抜けた

cuts.image_prompt: extreme close-up of cracked weathered concrete on the overpass deck, a man's fingertip in a worn gray suit sleeve tracing along a crack, warm sunset light
cuts.motion_prompt: The man's fingertip slowly traces along the crack in the concrete. Fine dust drifts. Camera still.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: 俺の仕事は損害保険のリスク査定。人の『もしも』に値段をつけること

cuts.memo: ひび割れを指でなぞる

cuts.image_prompt: medium shot, Ren looking down at the tablet in his left hand with a tired expression, on the old rusty overpass, orange sunset backlight
cuts.motion_prompt: The tired man looks down at his tablet and slowly breathes out. Subtle slow push in.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: この橋の事故確率、年0.3%。……高いな

cuts.memo: 事故確率の表示を編集で重ねる

cuts.image_prompt: the boy running happily toward the camera along the cracked overpass, randoseru bouncing, low camera angle
cuts.motion_prompt: The boy runs happily toward the camera along the overpass, the red school backpack bouncing with each step. Camera slowly moves back.

cuts.image_prompt: extreme close-up of Ren's tired gray eyes suddenly focusing, sunset reflected in his eyes
cuts.motion_prompt: The man's half-closed eyes suddenly widen and focus. The sunset reflection shimmers in his eyes. Very slow push in.
cuts.memo: 蓮の目が足元のひびに向く

cuts.image_prompt: medium shot, Ren raising his right hand slightly, calm serious face, speaking, on the old rusty overpass
cuts.motion_prompt: The man raises his right hand slightly and speaks calmly. Camera still.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: そこ、走らないほうがいい

cuts.image_prompt: the boy stopping abruptly on the overpass with a surprised face, a chunk of concrete breaking off and falling through the deck one step in front of him
cuts.motion_prompt: The boy stops abruptly in surprise. The chunk of concrete in front of him breaks off and falls down through the hole, dust bursting up.
cuts.se: かすかにポキッ（8話の伏線）
cuts.memo: セリフが2秒未満なので口パク合成の対象外

cuts.image_prompt: on the left in the foreground: Ren seen in profile; in the distance: the boy walking away along the overpass
cuts.motion_prompt: The boy walks away into the distance along the overpass. The man stays still in the foreground and mutters. Camera still.

cuts.image_prompt: Ren walking across the overpass, the concrete under his feet cracking and sinking, dust rising, dynamic low angle
cuts.motion_prompt: The concrete under the man's feet cracks and collapses. He loses his balance with a shocked face. Dust bursts up, strong camera shake.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: 他人の死は、だいたい見抜けた

cuts.image_prompt: seen from below, Ren falling backward through the air below the broken overpass, debris floating around him, tablet slipping from his hand, sunset sky above
cuts.motion_prompt: Slow motion: the man falls backward through the air below the broken overpass, concrete debris and the tablet tumbling around him.

cuts.image_prompt: close-up of Ren's deadpan expressionless face while falling, hair and necktie blown upward by the wind, sunset sky behind
cuts.motion_prompt: Close-up while falling: his hair and necktie flutter violently upward in the wind. His face stays completely deadpan. Small debris drifts past.
cuts.memo: 落下しながら真顔。顔が別人にならないよう基準画像を参照

cuts.se: 水音／エンドカードでポキッ
cuts.memo: 暗転→エンドカード（編集で作る）
